en: Black‑and‑white winter view of a narrow snow‑covered medieval street running between a high rough stone wall on the right and lower houses on the left. Heavy snow lies on roofs and the roadway where two small human figures walk away from the camera. In the background rises a large round stone tower with a conical roof, part of a city wall. An ornate wall‑mounted street lamp projects over the lane.
